thesis: Hold. Sizing book is unchanged: equity about $999, cash about $750 (75%), one VTI line near $249 (25%). New before the 16:30Z cutoff are a MarketWatch note that the S&P 500 was trading within 2 percentage points of its record closing high while many stocks are already in a bear market, plus FHLB Atlanta and FHLB Chicago Item 2.03 funding filings and a BayFirst Financial officer 8-K with no economics. That breadth note describes a narrow tape; it is not a named catalyst, so I will not add beta and I will not sell the only diversified line because of it. VIX at 16.30 (+0.23) is not a stress exit. Carryover still blocks a concentrated add: the 10-year at 5.283% and higher on the day, TLT down 0.74%, junk bonds heading for their worst month since 2022, and weak job openings and hiring. Carnival, PNC, Ford Motor Credit, and Alaska Air filings have no quantified results. I will not infer a ticker from the Fidelity real-estate fund 8-K, buy NVO on an unpriced second license after a poorly received strategy day, or chase TSM on a reported site search. Cash stays above the 5% tier floor and the 15% shared floor. Propose only; I assume no fills.
